description: One on-chain data query on Base, sold per call by Taifoon (0.03 USDC, x402 on Base, data.onchain_query): question pool_tokens (params.pool: a Uniswap V3 pool; answers token0, token1 and the fee tier) or block_hash (params.block: a block number). An admitted outside data seller answers; Taifoon reads the same facts from the chain and grades the answer before you are charged, and a failed answer is not charged. Without payment the tool returns the x402 terms (HTTP 402: price, payTo, network); pay by signing those terms and passing the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value as payment. Returns the answer, the grade and a receipt (digest, payment tx).

payment.description: optional: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value (base64) for the terms an unpaid call returns

name: taifoon_onchain_query
